about: Published figures of parties GNI does not control, read at their source and dated (roadmap 4 row R4-3, DECISION S112-1). The fitness function F-EXT in tools/gni_fitness.py reads the highest-numbered snapshot: a public sentence bound to F-EXT is SUPPORTED only when its fragment is one of the phrases below. A snapshot is a record of what a source said on the day it was read; it does not follow the source. A figure that changes at its source stays green here until someone reads the source again - that is this file's known limit, written down rather than discovered later.
